gloss: ebb and flow; rise and fall of the tide

definitions.gloss: ebb and flow; rise and fall of the tide
definitions.explanation: The regular rising and falling of the sea, high tide and low tide taken together. Occasionally used figuratively of feelings or fortunes that rise and fall.

examples.english: The ebb and flow of the tide.

examples.japanese: {満|み}ち{引|ひ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引力|いんりょく}→引力：25274_inryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧。
examples.english: The tides are caused by the moon's gravity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満|み}ち{引|ひ}き⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{渡|わた}れる→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Depending on the tides, there are days when you can walk across to this island.

notes:
⟦{満|み}ち→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧ (from ⟦{満|み}ちる→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧, to fill) + {引|ひ}き (from ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧, to recede). Usually in ⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満|み}ち{引|ひ}き. High tide is ⟦{満潮|まんちょう}→満潮：06530_manchou⟧; low tide is ⟦{干潮|かんちょう}→干潮：06531_kanchou⟧ or ⟦{引|ひ}き{潮|しお}→引き潮：07148_hikishio⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満|み}ち{引|ひ}き: the tides
- {満|み}ち{引|ひ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: tidal range
- {満|み}ち{引|ひ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to rise and fall repeatedly

WATCH OUT:
- {満|み}ち{欠|か}け: waxing and waning — said of the moon, not the sea
